verdict.rationale: Airwallex exposes payouts/transfers and balance data via its API and CLI, and AgentOS explicitly lists 'reading balances' and 'building cashflow reports' as agent skills, with production-scoped API keys, CLI, and MCP servers letting an agent programmatically pull and act on this data (awx-supp-agentos, awx-supp-cli, airwallex-docs-12). However, there is no explicit documentation of a balance-transactions endpoint or a pre-built reconciliation workflow matching deposits to underlying charges — missing for 10: a named balance-transactions API/report, an explicit deposit-to-charge reconciliation skill or example, and independent evidence of this reconciliation being performed end-to-end.
